question: What is the meaning of volume fraction of reused or recirculated water in the production of the product in relation to water reuse or recirculation?
data_point: volume fraction of reused or recirculated water in the production of the product
description: The volume fraction of reused or recirculated water in the production of the product refers to the proportion of water that is collected, treated, and reused or recirculated back into the production process, rather than being discarded as waste. This metric is used to assess the efficiency and sustainability of water use in manufacturing processes.
